decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits close to the core offer, has its own page and fits the firm's push toward data-driven airport operations, so this cheap, promising option should stay open.
The connectivity module is still only mentioned, but as a low-cost software add-on to the installed apron base its value remains uncertain rather than disproven, so keeping it is justified.

Billing software lies furthest from the operational core and shows little visibility, yet its upkeep cost is low and two years is still limited evidence, so the option stays open with elevated withdrawal risk.
Equipment monitoring feeds the service and maintenance business on the installed base, so this inexpensive option keeps strategic value even though it is only mentioned on the website.
